priorStatuses.title: Handle missing cache entries before trimming

findings.title: [P1] Issued authentication tokens are exposed in logs
findings.body: Every token passed to `recordIssuedToken` is forwarded to `console.log`, placing a replayable authentication credential in browser, CI, or centralized logs accessible to parties who should not possess it. Audit only non-secret metadata or a non-reversible identifier.

findings.title: [P2] Unvalidated return URL enables an open redirect
findings.body: `location.assign` accepts absolute cross-origin URLs, and the exported login completion function now navigates directly to any supplied string. A crafted login return URL can therefore send users to an attacker-controlled site after authentication. Restrict redirects to validated same-origin paths or an allowlist.
